date_basis: Local Asia/Shanghai date for handoff; raw report timestamps are in the JUnit files

source.code_version_basis: sha256 over json(sorted {path: sha256}) of tracked agent/, web/ and scripts/ blobs at commit 320549f

scope: MCP servers remain configuration revisions (kind='mcp'); no second configuration system, no V1 YAML or code import

Frozen v0037 adds mcp_servers/catalogs/tools/grants/run_tools/action_bindings/calls with 16 triggers: state whitelists, immutable evidence, authorization requiring the current catalog fingerprint and authority epoch, one live grant per tool, run captures frozen per run, unknown calls always stamped and reasoned
stdio transport owns one JSON-RPC subprocess per server generation (initialize, paginated tools/list, tools/call) through OwnedProcess; stderr is drained with metadata-only accounting
Streamable HTTP transport supports JSON and SSE responses, Mcp-Session-Id, bearer/OAuth tokens from the vault, bounded timeouts, no redirects, and never starts OAuth on 401

Catalog and tool fingerprints are name + inputSchema hashes (descriptions excluded); drift revokes grants, increments authority_epoch and forces explicit re-confirmation, while a stale page gets mcp_catalog_changed

Model exposure is per-run and agent-tier only: mcp__<server>__<tool> ToolSpecs with owner-declared read-only writes flag; unauthorized tools are invisible, dispatch revalidates the grant after approval and immediately before sending

Explicit OAuth 2.0 authorization-code flow with PKCE(S256), single-use 120s state, loopback-only /oauth/callback, dynamic client registration, vault token storage and refresh-only renewal; a completed authorization revokes old grants and requires reconnect

Eleven authenticated /api/v1 MCP endpoints plus a root-level OAuth callback and a new workbench partition (passive state, explicit connect/disconnect/reset, per-tool schema review, call records) at 390/1024
pending: Real external MCP servers and a real OAuth provider acceptance (recorded as pending real acceptance; fake stdio/HTTP providers are not real-network evidence)
Automatic bounded reconnect/backoff policy and cross-process session sharing are not implemented; reconnection is explicit
Complete D6 plugin chain/marketplace, D7 default-entry switch, three-platform real model/device/load/72h evidence

The same source also ran the full suite once; its 16 failures and 10 errors reproduce on baseline be58739 or predate this batch, so they are not batch regressions.
